title: Go Basics
description: Go from zero to comfortable in Go. Short, test-driven challenges that build on each other: syntax and values first, then the type system, then the parts of Go you cannot get anywhere else — goroutines, channels, and interfaces that stay small.

roadmap.title: Hello, Gofinity
roadmap.summary: Your first Go program: packages, func main, and returning a string from a function.

roadmap.title: Variables and Constants
roadmap.summary: var, :=, zero values, typed and untyped constants, and iota.

roadmap.title: Basic Types and Conversion
roadmap.summary: Integers, floats, runes, strings and bytes, and why Go makes you convert explicitly.

roadmap.title: Control Flow
roadmap.summary: if with an init statement, the one-and-only for loop, switch without fallthrough.

roadmap.title: Functions and Multiple Returns
roadmap.summary: Multiple return values, named results, variadic parameters, and closures.

roadmap.title: Slices and Arrays
roadmap.summary: Length versus capacity, append, slicing, copy, and the aliasing traps.

roadmap.title: Maps
roadmap.summary: Building maps, the comma-ok lookup, deletion, and iterating in an undefined order.

roadmap.title: Structs
roadmap.summary: Composite types, literals, embedding, and struct tags.

roadmap.title: Methods and Pointers
roadmap.summary: Pointer versus value receivers, and when a method can mutate.

roadmap.title: Interfaces
roadmap.summary: Implicit satisfaction, small interfaces, type switches, and the nil interface trap.

roadmap.title: Errors
roadmap.summary: Errors as values, wrapping with %w, errors.Is and errors.As, custom error types.

roadmap.title: Goroutines
roadmap.summary: Starting concurrent work and waiting for it with sync.WaitGroup.

roadmap.title: Channels
roadmap.summary: Unbuffered and buffered channels, closing, range over a channel, and select.

roadmap.title: Generics
roadmap.summary: Type parameters, constraints, and when a generic helper beats an interface.

roadmap.title: Testing
roadmap.summary: Table-driven tests, subtests, t.Helper, and benchmarks.
